Shankar Govind Gadewar vs The State Of Maharashtra on 24
February, 2022
Author: Vibha Kankanwadi
Bench: Vibha Kankanwadi
               IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
                          BENCH AT AURANGABAD
     907 ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO.208 OF 2022
                        SHANKAR GOVIND GADEWAR
                                   VERSUS
                       THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA
                                      ...
             Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Gadegaonkar Bharat N.
                 APP for Respondent-State : Mr. B. V. Virdhe
                                      ...
                                    CORAM : SMT.VIBHA KANKANWADI, J.
DATE : 24-02-2022 PER COURT :
1. Heard learned Advocate Mr. B. N. Gadegaonkar for the applicant.
2. Learned APP has strong objection for grant of interim relief as the matter is
coming for the first time and he is yet to receive the papers. He also submits that the
huge banned articles were found with co-accused, and taking into consideration the
papers for which the articles have been banned, sympathy need not be shown to the
applicant.
3. Perusal of the FIR would show that the name of the present applicant has not been
reflected and it appears that the name of the present applicant has been disclosed by
co-accused. It is then required to be seen as to what role has been attributed by the
co-
2 ABA 208-2022 accused to the present applicant, but then till the papers are perused, the liberty of
the applicant need not be curtailed.
4. Issue notice to the respondent-State, stand over to 14-03- 2022.
5. Learned APP waives notice for respondent-State.

6. In the meantime, in the event of arrest of the applicant Shankar Govind Gadekar, in connection
with Crime No.390 of 2021, registered with Mukhed Police Station, District Nanded, for the offence
punishable under Section 188, 272, 273, 328 read with 34 of IPC and under Section 59 of Food
Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he be released on PR of Rs.30,000/- (thirty thousand) with two
solvent sureties of Rs.15,000/- each (fifteen thousand).
7. Applicant shall attend Police Station Mukhed, District Nanded, on each Wednesday and Friday
between 10.00 a.m. to 12.00 p.m. till further orders.
(SMT. VIBHA KANKANWADI) JUDGE vjg/-.
